lines.en: label yukispring3:
scene yukiatthedoor1
: Can you shut the fuck up about my tits?! It’s every fucking day with you! You literally never stop!
: Oh my fucking- fine! I’ll leave! She’s probably not fucking here anyway. I have a better chance of finding her passed out in a fucking alley somewhere.
scene yukiatthedoor2
: Oh — and if I do, I’ll fucking kill her myself. Mark my fucking words. Stupid piece of shit fucking worthless mother! Fuck!
Yuki Yamaguchi could do little more than let her cigarette burn as she sat there, pressed against the wall and listening to the footsteps of her daughter fade away.
At first, she wanted to talk to her. She wanted to try and explain things or apologize or...really just do anything but vanish.
But upon reflection, she understood that vanishing was what would be best for the girl. And that reappearing at all was a mistake.
She should have never come back. She should have died, passed out in a fucking alley somewhere, just like her daughter said.
But old habits got the best of her and forced her to fight. To try and preserve the little bit of life she still clung to.
In that context, fighting meant turning things around. It meant getting clean — sifting through countless trash bins to find the puzzle pieces that fell from her pockets on laps around the city.
She remembers the wind in her hair. She remembers the lights. God, she loved those lights — and how they’d always guide her home, even when they were blurred by the speed of her bike.
Nowadays, everything was blurry — a side effect of pumping every illicit substance she could find into her body to try and shock it back to life.
Gone were the days of fighting to live. Now, she just wanted to fight.
And it didn’t matter what. It didn’t matter who. So she settled on fighting herself as a means of accelerating a long overdue punishment she’d always known would catch up to her.
scene black
She never thought it’d be like this, though.
scene yukiatthedoor3
She takes another drag of her cigarette, unsure of what sort of effect its toxicity would have on her decaying physical form. But again, that didn’t matter much now.
scene yukiatthedoor4
: Hah...
The locks had been changed. Yumi’s number had been blocked. And she’d even taken the liberty of informing her neighbors that she didn’t want her daughter around here anymore.
Of course that raised questions — but people seldom questioned Yuki. Because even when she was in the wrong, which she so commonly was, she could sound like she wasn’t.
A skill acquired to better get the things she wanted whenever she wanted them. And one not at all dissimilar from those who ran the same laps around the city.
scene yukiatthedoor5
But still, there was one thing she wanted that she would deprive herself of — and it must have been halfway around the block by now.
This could be the last time she ever heard her voice.
It probably wouldn’t be. But it could be. And despite how accustomed she had become to thinking such a thing, it did little to numb the pain. That’s where the drugs came in.
But even those were losing their luster. And Yuki was quickly learning that despite how good they could make her feel, they would never kill the fear of death.
After thirty-eight years, she had finally run out of gas.
And she would die in this room whether she liked it or not.
scene yukiatthedoor6
She taps on a name in her phone and takes a sip from a potion she used to believe would grant her eternal life. Or at least it was something she would joke about when it was still fun to joke at all.
All things considered, alcohol was the least of her worries. It wasn’t her liver that was rotting, after all. That much she knew.
But it didn’t change the fact that this very elixir was the same one that took the lives of girls she used to know before venturing off into the world alone.
scene yukiatthedoor7
As the phone continued to ring, she remembered a friend who’d drink mouthwash when she couldn’t get her hands on alcohol.
And as she, in her drunken stupor, kicked over a stack of cans that spilled violently onto a small bundle of hypodermic needles, she thanked herself for never being that pathetic.
: Hel-
: ‘Bout fuckin’ time you picked up.
scene yukiatthedoor8
: About time you called.
: Guessing you’ve already heard the news then, huh? Fucking brat — sharing personal information with her goddamn teacher of all people.
: Are you drunk?
: I’m a whole fuckin’ bunch of things, Akira. Drunk is just one of ‘em.
: Anyway, you still want to fuck me? So bored that I’m fuckin’ dying over here. Get it?
: That’s not funny, Yuki.
scene yukiatthedoor9
: Oh, would you fuckin’ grow a pair? Come on. That was a little funny. Admit it.
: I disagree. But I’m sure I have at least one friend who would find it hilarious.
: Oh yeah? Bring them over too. I’m fuckin’ everybody tonight. Gotta go out with a bang, you know?
: So you get cancer and...what? You just start using puns all the time?
: Who cares? You coming or not?
: No, Yuki. I am not coming over there to fuck you. I’m pissed off at you for hiding this from me and even more pissed off that you think I’d overlook that just to get in your pants.
: The fuck do you have to be mad about, huh? Yumi, I get. You, though? You’re just some random fucking guy. We don’t actually give a shit about each other, do we?
scene yukiatthedoor10
: Hello? Helloooooooo?
: I’m trying not to hold it against you because I know you’re fucked up right now. But that hurt, Yuki. I really do care about you.
: Oh yeah? Then name three good things about me. Go on. I’m listening.
: I don’t think I can, to be honest. You’re a pretty terrible person.
: Ha! Now THAT is funny!
: There don’t need to be any good things about you for me to like you, though. For example, there’s nothing good about me and plenty of people like me.
: Well hey- that’s fuckin’ great, man. It’s really cool you’ve got a whole fuckin’ fan club and I’ve got god damn fucking Rika and that’s it.
: You had Sara too until you shat all over her. How’s that working out for you?
scene yukiatthedoor11
: Fuckin’ horrible. I’m broke as shit now- which is actually the real reason I’m calling. Can you lend me some money for laundry? I’m outta clean clothes.
: How much do you need?
: Hundred-grand maybe?
: A hundred-thousand yen? You really expect me to believe you have that much laundry when I’ve only seen you wear a total of three outfits?
: Aww, you kept track? Tell you what — you come over now and I’ll let you fuck me in all three of them.
: I’m not lending you any money, Yuki. Not knowing what you’d use it for.
: Not even if I say it’s for hospital bills?
: That’s what Yumi found, you know. She tell you that? Bitch ripped up the damn bill and left it in pieces all over the floor. Hell of a thing to come home to, you know.
: Like, it’s one thing to find out you’re dying. But not knowing what you owe on top of that? Man. Life’s fuckin-
: Are you actually dying, Yuki? Like...what...what is it, exactly?
: Like, what kinda cancer? How long do I have? That what you want to know? You don’t want to be surprised?
: By you suddenly dying one day? Not really, no.
: What if I told you I only have a week left?
: Yuki-
: Would you spend all of it with me?...Read me bedtime stories?...Hold me in those fuckin’ wimpy ass noodle arms of yours and kiss me on the forehead all cute-like?
: Please don’t joke with me right now.
: What if it was a month? A year, even. How long could I get you to stay with me before you leave, Akira? Tell me. How long?
: I’m not the one you really want by your side right now. We both know that.
scene yukiatthedoor12
: You need to talk to her, Yuki. She’s not taking it well.
: She was...
: She was just here...a little while ago.
: She was? So you talked to her then?
scene yukiatthedoor13
: No, I...kinda just sat up against the door and...didn’t do shit.
: She might’ve been with somebody? Was talkin’ to someone. Either that or I’m just high as fuck. Hell, maybe she was never here at all and I just hallucinated the whole damn thing?
: Please talk to her. You owe her that much. And if things are really as bad as you’re making them sound-
: I don’t..um...
: I don’t really know...how bad things are...exactly...
scene yukiatthedoor14
: ...What?
: Yeah...I had other appointments and like...follow-up shit scheduled, but...
: I sort of just...didn’t go...
: You...didn’t go...
: It’s in my lungs, Akira. Surprise, surprise.
: Yuki, what the fuck do you mean you didn’t go? How much do you know? Did they tell you how serious it is?
scene yukiatthedoor15
: They can still do something, can’t they? I’ll go with you if you want. But if you sit back and just let this happen, who knows how bad it can get? Why don’t you just-
: Because I’m fucking scared, okay?!
scene yukiatthedoor16
: That’s why I haven’t gone back! Am I not allowed to be scared?!
: I don’t want to fucking die, Akira! Why is this happening to me?! Why now?! Everything was so good! I’m so fucking scared! I don’t know what to do!
: Neither do I, but I know that running away from it will only make it worse. You need to fight, Yuki.
: All I’ve ever done is fight! But this is...it’s different! I don’t think I...I don’t think I can win this one, Akira...I don’t know if...I just...
scene yukiatthedoor17
: I don’t have it in me anymore...
: If the news is bad...then what? Do they tell me how long I have? Because you might want to know, but I don’t...
: I don’t want to know any of it...what’ll happen to my body...my lungs...and that’s not even mentioning my fucking brain. I’ve been smoking since I was like eleven. I don’t know how not to.
: So what then? You’re just going to sit in the dark and hide from your daughter until Rika finds you dead on the floor? Is that the plan?
: There is no plan...I’m just scared...
: I’m so fucking scared...I don’t want to die...
scene yukiatthedoor18
: I don’t want to die! I can’t do this! I’ve never been this scared about ANYTHING before and I’ve had fucking GUNS pointed at me, Akira! Why were those less scary than this?!
: What if there’s nothing after this?! What if it’s just fucking...dark and...what if everything just ends?! What then?! Am I just gone?! After all of this, am I just gone?!
: What good was trying to fix everything then?! What good was trying at all?!
: That’s why I’m fucking using and drinking and killing MYSELF again because it’s better for me to do it than a fucking SICKNESS, Akira! Fuck! I’m so scared! I’m so-
: Yuki? Are you there?
: Someone’s here.
scene yukiatthedoor19
: What?
: It’s Yumi...she never left...
: Oh God, she never fucking left and now she’s heard me screaming all of that shit?! What do I do now?!
: You hang up on me and talk to her instead. If anyone can convince you to get help, it’s her. Not me.
: She’s gonna fucking hate me, Akira...more than she already does...I came back into her life just to fucking die and she’s never going to trust anyone again...it’s all my fault...
: It’s all my fucking fault!
: Hang up. The fucking. Phone. And answer. The door.
: Can I keep you on speaker?...
: Yuki, I love you. I hope you get help. I’m hanging up now.
: Akira, wait!
scene yukiatthedoor20
: Oh god...oh no...
: How do I...where do I even...
scene yukiatthedoor21
: JUST GO AWAY! PLEASE! I’M SORRY FOR EVERYTHING!
: I’M SORRY FOR LEAVING YOU! I’M SORRY FOR BEING AN ADDICT! I’M SORRY FOR COMING BACK AND I’M SORRY FOR ABANDONING YOU AGAIN! I’M SORRY! I’M SO FUCKING-
: Aunt Yuki! Open the door! Right now!
scene yukiatthedoor22
: ...Kaori? Is that you?...
: Yes, Aunt Yuki...
: Now please...
scene black
: Open the door...
